name: name
definition: The name function returns a string representing the QName of the first node in a given node-set.

functionParameters.description: The QName of the first node in this node-set will be returned. If this argument is omitted, the current context node will be used.

returnValue: A string representing the QName of a node.
descriptions: The QName is the node's qualified name, including its namespace prefix and its local name.
